about: Aethera Studio is a working reference for an agency or studio: the hero section laid out, measured and ready to rebuild. The page's own headline reads “Beyond silence, we build the eternal”, and the composition is built around those exact words. The colour scheme is white #FFFFFF underneath and black #000000 for the type, and the page is set in Instrument Serif. The build is React and Tailwind CSS; every measurement in it is written down, which is what makes it reusable. The motion budget is 100ms transitions. Keep it open while you write: the 3,169-character brief is the part that transfers to your own page.

layout.title: Navigation without a background
layout.body: The bar is one row of text and one action, measured at 75px spacing steps and 100ms transitions so it reads as a strip rather than as a band. The bar sits over the 800x582 composition without a background of its own, so the media runs edge to edge underneath it. Give the wordmark no more room than its type needs.

layout.title: One family, two roles
layout.body: The display line is set in Instrument Serif at a size the brief fixes, which makes the headline a composition element rather than a paragraph. The face is paired with fixed sizes, which is what keeps the display line and the interface text related. Check the scale in greyscale.

layout.title: A bar with nothing spare
layout.body: The bar overlays the hero section instead of pushing it down, so the composition keeps the full height of the first screen. Copy this pattern when you need navigation that survives a loud first screen.

layout.title: The sizes are in the brief, not in a scale
layout.body: The brief states its sizes at capture (75px spacing steps and 100ms transitions), so a rebuild can be verified instead of approximated. A rebuild that hits those numbers looks like the reference without further tuning.

motion.title: The whole animation budget
motion.body: One duration covers the interactions (100ms), which is what keeps hover and press reading as one system. Nothing waits on a scroll position, so the page responds the moment you touch it.

motion.title: A small interactive surface
motion.body: The interactive layer is small and predictable: hover states on the buttons and links rather than on every card. Everything else stays still, which keeps the emphasis on the composition. A control that looks interactive behaves interactively, so there are no false affordances. Check the states on a touch device.

editorial.title: What to change first in Aethera Studio
editorial.body: Compare this with starting from a blank page. Here the frame (800x582) and 75px spacing steps and 100ms transitions are already decided, so the work is substitution rather than composition. Keep the frame and the scale; the subject is the part that should change.

editorial.title: What this hero section gets right
editorial.body: One screen means one decision for the reader, and that is the cost of this layout: everything else moves below the fold. The brief states 75px spacing steps and 100ms transitions so the lower sections keep the same rhythm. Aethera Studio states the offer once and lets the composition repeat it rather than adding a second claim.

editorial.title: How the hero section reflows
editorial.body: The desktop composition is solved against 800x582, and the narrow layout is designed rather than inherited: the scale is fluid rather than stepped. Motion has a reduced-motion branch, and the media carries a poster frame so the page still communicates when autoplay is unavailable. The scale changes with the viewport; the sequence does not.

faq.question: What does the brief behind Aethera Studio actually contain?
faq.answer: The captured brief runs 3,169 characters and covers the frame, the type scale, the palette and the transitions. Copying it gives you that text, and sending it to Studio stages the same request with the page already described.

faq.question: Can I rebuild the Aethera Studio hero section in a different stack?
faq.answer: Aethera Studio was built in React and Tailwind CSS, and the entry says so for provenance. The brief describes positions, sizes and timings, so it rebuilds in any framework that can set type and place elements.

faq.question: How much of Aethera Studio is animated?
faq.answer: Transitions are attached to interface states rather than to a scroll timeline, and they resolve in the 100ms range. The brief records the values so a port can match them without guessing.
